claim: Snapshot.memory[0:0x4000] is all zeros for .z80 files; take ROM bytes from skoolkit.ROM48 and verify any ROM copy against it at every ROM byte the game reads.

evidence.text: The first hardware build had blank dialogue text: the slot-1 page was built from Snapshot.memory[0:0x4000], which is zeros for .z80 files; ROM bytes come from skoolkit.ROM48.
evidence.quote: Snapshot.memory[0:0x4000], which is ZEROS for .z80 files - always take ROM bytes from skoolkit.ROM48.
